description: This file defines an abstract assertion class for Command objects within the Eclipse Ditto project, providing methods to verify command properties such as type, headers, resource paths, and manifests.

classes.name: AbstractCommandAssert
classes.description: An abstract assertion class for Command objects, providing customizable assertion methods for command properties.

methods.name: AbstractCommandAssert
methods.description: Constructor initializing the assertion with the actual Command object and setting up the type of the assertion.

methods.name: withType
methods.description: Asserts that the Command's type matches the expected value.

methods.name: hasDittoHeaders
methods.description: Asserts that the Command contains the expected Ditto headers.

methods.name: hasCorrelationId
methods.description: Asserts that the Command has the expected correlation ID.

methods.name: withDittoHeaders
methods.description: Asserts that the Command's headers match the expected headers.

methods.name: withResourcePath
methods.description: Asserts that the Command's resource path matches the expected JsonPointer.

methods.name: withManifest
methods.description: Asserts that the Command's manifest matches the expected value.

methods.name: assertThatEquals
methods.description: Helper method to assert equality between actual and expected values with a custom error message.
